title: Adhyaya 10: Classical Duties & Dharma
summary: Canonical verses on traditional righteousness from Adhyaya 10.
ai_summary: Exposition of ethical conduct and cosmic law according to Sage Manu in Adhyaya 10.

verses.original: अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं शौचमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः । एतं सामासिकं धर्मं चातुर्वर्ण्येऽब्रवीन्मनुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ahiṁsā satyamasteyaṁ śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ | etaṁ sāmāsikaṁ dharmaṁ cāturvarṇye'bravīnmanuḥ ||
verses.translation: Non-injury (Ahimsa), truthfulness (Satya), non-stealing (Asteya), purity (Shaucha), and restraint of the senses (Indriya-nigraha) — this, in brief, Manu declared as the universal Dharma for all four orders.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: The universal moral baseline binding upon every human being regardless of caste or vocation.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: Non-injury (Ahimsa), truthfulness (Satya), non-stealing (Asteya), purity (Shaucha), and restraint of the senses (Indriya-nigraha) — this, in brief, Manu declared as the universal Dharma for all four orders.

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
layers.content: मनुस्मृती अध्याय 10: The universal moral baseline binding upon every human being regardless of caste or vocation.

verses.original: न जात्या ब्राह्मणो भवति न क्षत्रियो न वैश्यकः । वृत्तेन हि भवत्यार्यः शीलमेव गरीयसी ॥
verses.transliteration: na jātyā brāhmaṇo bhavati na kṣatriyo na vaiśyakaḥ | vṛttena hi bhavatyāryaḥ śīlameva garīyasī ||
verses.translation: Not by birth alone does one become a Brahmana, Kshatriya, or Vaishya; by conduct alone does one become noble (Arya), for character is supreme.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: Conduct and noble character are the true measures of an enlightened human being.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: Not by birth alone does one become a Brahmana, Kshatriya, or Vaishya; by conduct alone does one become noble (Arya), for character is supreme.

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
layers.content: मनुस्मृती अध्याय 10: Conduct and noble character are the true measures of an enlightened human being.
